teaser: The laminator at the print shop counter jams on the same sheet twice before anyone behind you sighs. You smooth it, try again, apologize to no one in particular — a decent picture of what a life path 2, carried in an ENFJ, does with most of an ordinary day: smoothing, adjusting, keeping the line moving without raising a voice. The number asks for harmony between people; the type turns harmony into something closer to leadership, pulling a room toward its better version rather than just keeping peace inside it. Cross the two and the quiet work of a 2 gets a stage it never asked for, while the stage gets someone who would rather fix the machine than be watched fixing it.
excerpt: The hum of the dryers at the laundromat covers most of a conversation, which might be why it's the place a hard thing finally gets said.
